integrity: All claimed strict inequalities certified using exact rational interval arithmetic; numerical RK4 and root approximations are corroborative. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar two-model horizon-two closed-loop benchmark, full-horizon application, no terminal penalty, independently resampled unbiased model, exact optimal controls; no claim for arbitrary stochastic MPC or numerical acceleration. Fractional moment root specified implicitly; threshold decimal is approximate.
title: A sharp fractional-moment gap and infinite expected cost in scalar randomized model predictive control
